# Current: Position D (rows 32-51, cols 4-15)
# Continue to Position I: D -> UP -> E -> UP -> G -> UP -> H -> UP -> I

print(f"Cells per action: {cells_list}")

def get_char_pos(seg):
    red_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] >= 50]

        return None

            all_cols.append(p[1])
    return (min(all_rows), max(all_rows), min(all_cols), max(all_cols))

pos = get_char_pos(current_frame.segmentation)
print(f"Current: rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")

# Check if we're at Position I (highest)
if pos[0] <= 12:

    # Try falling down

    print(f"After DOWN: rows {pos[0]}-{pos[1]}, cols {pos[2]}-{pos[3]}")
